notes: App Store redesign: a colourful Discover page with a rotating banner, category tiles, Popular, Recently updated and a Games and classic consoles row; each category has its own colour
Richer app pages: a screenshot gallery, version, last update, download size, licence, What's New, links, and More like this, tinted in the app's own colour
Sort by Popular, Name or Recently Updated, and filter to verified or open-source apps

More places to get apps: search also finds apps in Ubuntu's software library (asks for your password), and the App Store installs .deb, .flatpak and .AppImage files, by double-click or Options → Install from a File
Options menu: update apps automatically once a day, Free Up Space, and Installed now shows how much room each app takes
